newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land up after yearly results.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land up after yearly results.

text.p: Better-than-expected growth in yearly earnings boosted shares of Henderson Land Development Co Ltd on Thursday morning, brokers said on Thursday.
"Better-than-expected earnings growth plus anticipation of stronger income from sales of property projects are boosting demand," said Jason Tang from South China Brokerage.
The shares were boosted to a morning high of HK$62 in early trade before steadied at HK$61.25 in mid-morning on volume of 1.03 million shares worth HK$63.72 million.
Analysts said they expected the shares to undergo a downward correction in the short run after a recent rally.
Henderson Land posted a 19 percent rise in net profit in the year to June 30 to HK$8.36 billion, compared with the market consensus forecast of about 14 percent growth.
